title: fix(bot): wire transcriber into ForwardBatcher
body:
## Summary
- `ForwardBatcher` was constructed in `__main__.py` with `bot=bot` only, leaving `_transcriber` as `None`.
- `_process_batch` guards transcription on `if voice_snapshot and self._bot and self._transcriber:` — so the block was silently skipped, the \"⏳ Transcribing voice...\" status message was never edited, and CC received an empty prompt.
- Pass the already-built `Transcriber` instance into the constructor so voice actually reaches Deepgram.

## Test plan
- [x] \`uv run ruff check .\`
- [x] \`uv run ruff format --check .\`
- [x] \`uv run mypy src/ mcp-servers/bot/server.py\`
- [x] \`uv run pytest\` (13 passed)
- [x] Manual: sent a voice message in a forum project topic — transcript appears in the recognizing-status message and is forwarded to the agent.
